metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session-level workflow skill for Flink DataStream window aggregation that chains socket source, transformation, keying, windowing, and aggregation into one executable job. It does not semantically match any existing skill (which cover Python multiprocessing and GRPO reward scaling in different domains). Peer candidates (DataStream Transformation, Source Reading, Source Creation) are narrower, complementary skills at the same granularity but different stages/methods. The candidate integrates multiple stages (input, processing, windowing, aggregation) into a complete end-to-end session workflow, making it a distinct capability worthy of creation rather than merge or split.
